designer_note: The one market of MVP-1 (p1-03). Sell only. Positions are system_local metres (ADR-0009 section 1). (0, 1500, 0) sits 900 m above the star's surface and is the same distance from every spawn point of its Y parity (2,795 m / 3,052 m), so no actor's hashed spawn point is permanently closer to the money. Deposits keep their rarity gradient by distance from here: Ferrosite 4.2-4.4 km, Glacine 3.7-4.7 km, Cobaltine 6.3-7.3 km, Starfall Glass 9.2 km. Every number is a designer assumption; see docs/design/p1-03-trading.md. pricing_version names the price rules and listings below: changing any of them requires bumping it (server golden binds the normalised hash of these sections and fixed-input proceeds to this version).

rules.note: Docked iff |ship.position - position_m|^2 <= (radius_m + dock_range_from_surface_m)^2 and |ship.velocity|^2 <= max_ship_speed_mps^2, on the authoritative state at the START of the tick (same as mining). Price of band b = base_price_cr_per_kg * max(price_floor_pct, 100 - b * price_drop_pct_per_band) div 100 (integer floor division), b = saturation_kg div band_kg. A sale walks the bands, so proceeds do not depend on how a quantity is split. saturation_kg is capped at floor_band * band_kg, floor_band = ceil((100 - price_floor_pct) / price_drop_pct_per_band) = 7. At every tick that is a multiple of recovery_interval_s * tick_hz, saturation_kg = max(0, saturation_kg - recovery_kg) (lazy, same form as deposit regeneration).
